commit: fix(javascript): avoid linebreaks in embedded template interpolations

truth.description: printJestEachTemplateLiteral now hands inJestEach to printTemplateExpressions as an argument and no longer sets options.__inJestEach while it prints the table cells, but printArray in array.js still reads that flag to stop a matrix-like array from force-breaking, so a jest each cell such as ${[{ start: 1, end: 3 }, { start: 15, end: 20 }]} now prints across several lines and its table row loses the column alignment.

distractions.why: A template literal has exactly one expression fewer than it has quasis, so pushing expressionDocs[i] after every quasi but the last places each interpolation where the old truthiness check on expressionDoc did, now that every expression doc is a group object.
